properties.notes: Site is allocated as a Town Centre Key Opportunity Site for residential and/or town centre uses in Local Plan Policies EC6 (Development Sites within the Town Centre Boundary) and H2 (Key Housing Sites). Policies TC3 and H2 of the Regulation 19 consultation draft Local Plan Review document propose the retention of this allocation. Minimum figure of 50 is based on the figure given in the 2015 Local Plan Housing Trajectory.
